create_generic_client_interceptor: create a generic gRPC client interceptor using the create function with a custom intercept_call function
intercept_unary_unary_calls: intercept unary-unary gRPC calls by modifying client call details and request before continuation
intercept_unary_stream_calls: intercept unary-stream gRPC calls to transform request and postprocess the response iterator
intercept_stream_unary_calls: intercept stream-unary gRPC calls to modify the request iterator and postprocess the response
intercept_stream_stream_calls: intercept stream-stream gRPC calls to transform both request iterator and response iterator
